turns.question: How many delivery-topic customer service calls were there per 100 shipped orders in September 2026?
turns.answer: In September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) there was 1 delivery-topic call labelled and 50 shipped orders; the semantic layer has no calls-per-100-shipped metric, so I can't give that ratio from it.
